OffLimits Outlander is designed for men who prefer rugged, outdoor-inspired footwear with a bold and distinctive look. Its high-top silhouette and structured design make it a natural fit for outdoor settings, while the lace-up closure allows you to adjust the fit according to your preference.

The combination of a TPR sole and die-cut EVA insock brings together a firm underfoot base and added comfort inside the shoe. Designed as outdoor shoes for men, the Outlander works well for travel, outdoor outings and days spent exploring beyond the usual routine.

Its rugged silhouette makes it a versatile addition to outdoor-inspired looks, bringing together distinctive styling and practical comfort for different plans and surroundings.



Key Features

The velvet and synthetic upper combines a textured finish with a structured construction, giving the shoe a distinctive and rugged appearance.
A TPR sole creates a firm base underfoot, making it suitable for regular movement during outdoor plans and outings.
The die-cut EVA insock adds cushioning inside the shoe for a more comfortable feel during wear.
Lace-up closure lets you adjust the fit according to your preference for a more personalised feel.
The high-top silhouette adds to the shoe's bold, outdoor-inspired character while giving it a distinctive visual appeal.
Designed as outdoor shoes for men, the Outlander is suitable for travel, outdoor outings and exploring different surroundings.

Styling Tips and Look

Pair the OffLimits Outlander with cargo pants, denim or utility-style trousers to complement its rugged aesthetic. The high-top design also works well with layered looks featuring overshirts, casual jackets or hoodies, making it easy to style for travel, outdoor plans and relaxed weekend outings.
